paper.title_en: Quasinormal Modes of Reissner-Nordström Black Holes in Modified Gravity
paper.abstract_en: In the framework of Scalar-Tensor-Vector Gravity (STVG), this paper investigates the quasinormal modes and time-domain evolution of Reissner-Nordström Modified Gravity (MOG) black holes under massless scalar, electromagnetic, and gravitational perturbations. Quasinormal frequencies are calculated by extending the 3rd- to 6th-order WKB method and combining it with Padé approximation to the 13th order, while complete time-domain waveforms are obtained using a finite-difference method based on light-cone coordinates. The results indicate that increasing the MOG parameter $α$ raises the effective mass of the black holes, leading to a decrease in the damping rate $|ω_I|$ and a slower ringdown decay. An increase in charge $Q$ produces a similar effect, with the damping approaching zero in the near-extremal limit. Regarding the ringdown decay times for the three types of perturbations, the gravitational field has the longest duration, the electromagnetic field is intermediate, and the scalar field is the shortest. The oscillations and decay observed in the time-domain waveforms are qualitatively consistent with the frequency-domain results, and the power-law exponent governing the late-time tail aligns with that of asymptotically flat spacetimes. This study provides a systematic theoretical reference for testing modified gravity theories using black hole spectroscopy.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该论文在标量-张量-矢量引力（STVG）框架下系统研究Reissner-Nordström修正引力黑洞的准正规模与时间域演化，结合高阶WKB方法与Padé逼近以及基于光锥坐标的有限差分方法，并对引力、电磁、标量三类扰动的衰减时标与晚期尾幂律进行了比较，属于修改引力与黑洞扰动理论的基础性理论研究，理论深度较高且方法描述较完整，适合点击阅读。
decision.title_zh: 修正引力中Reissner-Nordström黑洞的准正规模
decision.abstract_zh: 在标量-张量-矢量引力（STVG）框架下，本文研究了Reissner-Nordström修正引力（MOG）黑洞在无质量标量、电磁和引力扰动下的准正规模和时域演化。准正规模频率通过将3阶至6阶WKB方法扩展并与13阶Padé近似相结合来计算，而完整的时间域波形则使用基于光锥坐标的有限差分方法获得。结果表明，增加MOG参数$\alpha$会提高黑洞的有效质量，导致阻尼率$|\omega_I|$减小以及铃宕衰减变慢。电荷$Q$的增加产生类似效应，在近极端极限下阻尼趋近于零。对于三类扰动的铃宕衰减时间，引力场持续时间最长，电磁场居中，标量场最短。时间域波形中观察到的振荡和衰减与频率域结果定性一致，并且控制晚期尾部的幂律指数与渐近平坦时空的幂律指数一致。本研究为利用黑洞谱学检验修改引力理论提供了系统的理论参考。
